tools.name: envia_validate_address
tools.title: Validate address
tools.description: Validate a postal code or look up a city to get the correct city, state, and country values. Use this before creating labels to prevent address-related errors. Provide either postal_code or city (or both). Country is always required (2-letter ISO code, e.g. MX, US, CO).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. MX, US, CO, BR)

city.description: City name to look up (e.g. Monterrey, Bogota). Used when postal code is unknown.

tools.name: envia_list_carriers
tools.title: List carriers
tools.description: List available shipping carriers for a country. Optionally include their services. Use this to find which carrier and service codes to pass to envia_quote_shipment or envia_create_shipment.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. MX, US, CO)

international.description: Set to true for international shipments, false (default) for domestic.

include_services.description: Set to true to also list available services per carrier.

tools.name: envia_quote_shipment
tools.title: Quote shipment
tools.description: Get shipping rates for a parcel shipment across ALL available carriers and services. Use this whenever the user asks "how much does it cost", "compare carriers", "what is the cheapest option to ship from X to Y", or "quote a shipment". Returns every service the company has access to, sorted by price (cheapest first), with delivery estimates and a per-service cost breakdown. Country handling: for MX, US, CA, BR and most countries provide postal codes (city and state are resolved automatically). For CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO provide city and state instead — postal code optional. Colombia example: origin_city="Bogota", origin_state="DC", origin_country="CO" — DANE codes auto-resolve. When NOT to use: (a) capability discovery for a single carrier (weight limits, COD support, allowed add-ons) → use envia_get_carrier_constraints; (b) listing global add-ons available for a route (insurance, COD, etc.) → use envia_list_additional_services first, then re-quote with the add-on; (c) creating the actual label after the user picks an option → use envia_create_shipment.

origin_postal_code.description: Origin postal / ZIP code. City and state are resolved automatically. Required for most countries (MX, US, CA, BR, etc.). Not needed for CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO — use origin_city instead.

destination_postal_code.description: Destination postal / ZIP code. City and state are resolved automatically. Required for most countries (MX, US, CA, BR, etc.). Not needed for CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO — use destination_city instead.

origin_country.description: Origin country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. MX, US, CO). Default: MX

origin_city.description: Origin city name. Required for CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO (no postal code needed). For CO: use the city name (e.g. "Bogota") — it will be translated to the DANE code automatically.

origin_state.description: Origin state / department code. Required for CO (e.g. "DC" for Bogota, "ANT" for Medellin). For other countries: resolved automatically from postal code.

destination_city.description: Destination city name. Required for CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO (no postal code needed). For CO: use the city name (e.g. "Medellin") — it will be translated to the DANE code automatically.

destination_state.description: Destination state / department code. Required for CO (e.g. "VAC" for Cali, "DC" for Bogota). For other countries: resolved automatically from postal code.

origin_district.description: Origin neighborhood / colonia. Encouraged for MX addresses — some carriers validate availability at this level. Auto-resolved from postal code if not provided.

destination_district.description: Destination neighborhood / colonia. Encouraged for MX addresses — some carriers validate availability at this level. Auto-resolved from postal code if not provided.

declared_value.description: Declared value for insurance (in origin currency)

carriers.description: Carrier code or comma-separated list (e.g. "dhl,fedex,estafeta"). Use "all" to query every available carrier for the origin country (default). Use envia_list_carriers to find available codes.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for pricing (e.g. "MXN", "USD"). Optional.

additional_services.description: Optional additional services for the shipment. Use envia_list_additional_services to discover available services for a route. Example: [{ "service": "adult_signature_required" }]

amount.description: Monetary amount when the service requires it (e.g. insurance value, COD amount).

data.description: Advanced: arbitrary data payload for multi-field services (ETD, hazmat, LTL appointment). Takes precedence over amount when both are provided.

insurance_type.description: Shortcut to add an insurance service. Sets additionalServices with the declared_value as amount. Only one insurance type allowed. "insurance" is carrier-native (CO/BR). "envia_insurance" is Envia platform insurance. "high_value_protection" for high-value packages.

cash_on_delivery_amount.description: Cash on delivery amount to collect from recipient. Adds a cash_on_delivery additional service automatically.

tools.name: envia_create_shipment
tools.title: Create shipment
tools.description: Purchase a shipping label. This charges your Envia account balance. Two modes: (1) pass order_identifier to auto-create from an ecommerce order, or (2) provide addresses and package details manually. City and state are resolved automatically from postal codes. Addresses are validated against country-specific required fields before generation. For BR-to-BR shipments, DCe (Declaracao de Conteudo Eletronica) authorization with SEFAZ is performed automatically — items with productCode (NCM) and identificationNumber (CPF/CNPJ) on both addresses are required. Pass xml_data to skip auto-authorization if you already have it. Returns: tracking number, label PDF URL, and tracking URL.

order_identifier.description: Ecommerce order identifier for one-step label creation. When set, origin/destination/packages are auto-populated from the order. Carrier is taken from the order quote unless overridden.

location_index.description: Which origin location to ship from (0-based). Default: 0 (first location). Only relevant when using order_identifier with multi-location orders.

origin_street.description: Sender street name (e.g. "Av. Constitución" for MX, "Rua Paracatu" for BR). For MX and BR, put only the street name here and use origin_number for the exterior number.

origin_number.description: Sender exterior house/building number. Required for MX and BR addresses (e.g. "123", "60"). For other countries the number is already part of origin_street and this field is ignored.

origin_interior_number.description: Sender interior number / suite / apartment (e.g. "4B", "Piso 2"). Required when the country's address form marks interior number as mandatory.

origin_district.description: Sender neighborhood (colonia for MX, bairro for BR). Auto-resolved from postal code for MX. Provide explicitly to override the auto-resolved value.

origin_city.description: Sender city. Auto-resolved from postal code for most countries. Required for CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO.

origin_state.description: Sender state / province code. Auto-resolved from postal code for most countries.

origin_country.description: Sender country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. MX). Required in manual mode.

origin_identification_number.description: Sender tax/national ID (e.g. RFC for MX, CNPJ/CPF for BR, NIT for CO). Required for BR shipments (DCe authorization).

destination_street.description: Recipient street name (e.g. "Calle Reforma" for MX, "Rua Célio Nascimento" for BR). For MX and BR, put only the street name here and use destination_number for the exterior number.

destination_number.description: Recipient exterior house/building number. Required for MX and BR addresses (e.g. "456", "196"). For other countries the number is already part of destination_street and this field is ignored.

destination_interior_number.description: Recipient interior number / suite / apartment (e.g. "4B", "Piso 2"). Required when the country's address form marks interior number as mandatory.

destination_district.description: Recipient neighborhood (colonia for MX, bairro for BR). Auto-resolved from postal code for MX. Provide explicitly to override the auto-resolved value.

destination_city.description: Recipient city. Auto-resolved from postal code for most countries. Required for CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO.

destination_state.description: Recipient state / province code. Auto-resolved from postal code.

destination_country.description: Recipient country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Required in manual mode.

destination_identification_number.description: Recipient tax/national ID (e.g. RFC for MX, CNPJ/CPF for BR, NIT for CO). Required for BR shipments (DCe authorization).

items.description: REQUIRED for international shipments and BR-to-BR domestic shipments. Array of items in the package for customs documentation and DCe authorization. Each item needs at least quantity and price. For BR, productCode (NCM) is also required.

description.description: Item description for customs (use English to avoid delays). Defaults to package_content when omitted.

quantity.description: Number of units of this item.

price.description: Unit price of the item — carriers need this for customs declarations and landed cost.

productCode.description: HS / tariff code, also known as NCM code in Brazil (e.g. "4202.21.6000", "8528.72.00"). Required for international shipments and BR-to-BR domestic shipments. Use envia_classify_hscode to look up the correct code for a product.

xml_data.description: Pre-authorized DCe (Declaracao de Conteudo Eletronica) data for BR shipments. When provided, auto-authorization with SEFAZ is skipped. Obtain this via a prior call to the /dce/autorizar endpoint.

carrier.description: Carrier code (e.g. "dhl", "fedex"). Required in manual mode. In ecommerce mode: overrides the order's pre-selected carrier.

service.description: Service code from envia_quote_shipment (e.g. "express"). Required in manual mode. In ecommerce mode: overrides the order's pre-selected service.

order_reference.description: Customer order number or reference to print on the label

print_format.description: Label format: PDF, ZPL, ZPLII, PNG, EPL. Auto-fetched from carrier if not provided.

print_size.description: Label size (e.g. STOCK_4X6, PAPER_4X6). Auto-fetched from carrier if not provided.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for declared values (e.g. "MXN", "USD"). Optional.

additional_services.description: Optional additional services for the shipment. Use envia_list_additional_services to discover available services for a route. Example: [{ "service": "adult_signature_required" }]

amount.description: Monetary amount when the service requires it (e.g. insurance value, COD amount).

data.description: Advanced: arbitrary data payload for multi-field services (ETD, hazmat, LTL appointment). Takes precedence over amount when both are provided.

insurance_type.description: Shortcut to add an insurance service. Uses package_declared_value as amount. Only one insurance type allowed. "insurance" is carrier-native (CO/BR). "envia_insurance" is Envia platform insurance. "high_value_protection" for high-value packages.

cash_on_delivery_amount.description: Cash on delivery amount to collect from recipient. Adds a cash_on_delivery additional service automatically.

tools.name: envia_track_package
tools.title: Track package
tools.description: Track one or more packages by their tracking numbers. Returns the current status and event history for each shipment. Does not require an API key or OAuth login — tracking is a public lookup.

tracking_numbers.description: One or more tracking numbers, comma-separated (e.g. '7520610403' or '7520610403,7520610404')

tools.name: envia_cancel_shipment
tools.title: Cancel shipment
tools.description: Cancel a shipment and void its label. On success, reports the refund amount (when posted), refund date, and any daily-limit or COD chargeback information. Not all carriers support cancellation — best results within the first 24 hours after label generation.

tracking_number.description: Tracking number of the shipment to cancel

tools.name: envia_schedule_pickup
tools.title: Schedule pickup
tools.description: Schedule a carrier pickup at a specific address and date/time window. You must have already created labels with envia_create_shipment — provide the tracking numbers. The carrier will arrive between time_from and time_to on the chosen date.

tracking_numbers.description: Comma-separated tracking numbers for the pickup (e.g. '752061,752062')

total_weight.description: Total weight of all packages in KG

instructions.description: Special instructions for the driver (e.g. 'Loading dock B, ring bell')

tools.name: envia_get_shipment_history
tools.title: Get shipment history
tools.description: List all shipments created in a given month. Returns tracking numbers, carriers, statuses, and route summaries. Useful for reports and reconciliation.

tools.name: envia_classify_hscode
tools.title: Classify hscode
tools.description: Classify a product into an HS code (known as NCM in Brazil) for customs and regulatory compliance. Describe the product in plain language and optionally specify destination countries. Returns the recommended HS/NCM code and alternatives. Use the code as productCode in items when calling envia_quote_shipment or envia_create_shipment for international shipments and BR-to-BR domestic shipments (required for DCe authorization).

description.description: Product description in plain language (e.g. 'cotton t-shirt', 'ceramic coffee mug', 'smart TV'). Use English for better results.

hs_code_provided.description: Optional: an HS code you already have, to validate or refine

destination_countries.description: Optional: comma-separated destination countries (ISO codes) for region-specific classification

include_alternatives.description: Include alternative HS code suggestions (default: true)

tools.name: envia_get_ecommerce_order
tools.title: Get ecommerce order
tools.description: Fetch an ecommerce order by its platform identifier and get ready-to-use shipment payloads. Returns order details, origin/destination addresses, package dimensions, and carrier info formatted for use with envia_quote_shipment and envia_create_shipment. Use this when the user provides an order number from their ecommerce platform (Shopify, Tiendanube, WooCommerce, etc.).

order_identifier.description: The ecommerce platform order identifier (e.g. Shopify order number, Tiendanube ID). This is the external identifier visible to merchants, not an internal database ID.

payload_type.description: Which payload format to return: "quote" for rate comparison, "generate" for label creation, or "both" (default) for both formats.

tools.name: envia_list_additional_services
tools.title: List additional services
tools.description: List optional additional services available for a shipment route. Use this before quoting or creating a shipment to discover which services (insurance, cash on delivery, signatures, etc.) can be requested. Results depend on the origin country, whether the shipment is international, and the shipment type. IMPORTANT: this returns the GLOBAL catalog for the route — it does NOT filter by a specific carrier. For "which add-ons does {carrier} support?" questions (e.g. FedEx, DHL, UPS specific), use `envia_get_carrier_constraints` with the carrier_id instead — that tool returns the list of add-ons that are actually available for the given carrier on this account.

origin_country.description: Origin country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. MX, CO, BR). Required.

destination_country.description: Destination country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Required for international shipments to get accurate service availability.

tools.name: envia_get_additional_service_prices
tools.title: Get additional service prices
tools.description: Get the pricing for all optional add-on services available on a specific carrier service. Returns standard prices and any company-level custom overrides. Use envia_list_carriers to find service IDs, or use the service_id from a quote response. Useful for showing the cost of insurance, COD, or signature services before creating a shipment.

service_id.description: Carrier service ID (numeric). Available from envia_list_carriers or a quote response.

tools.name: envia_get_carrier_constraints
tools.title: Get carrier constraints
tools.description: Get the full capability profile for a specific carrier: pickup window, per-service weight limits, COD configuration, drop-off support, optional add-on services available, and any company-level overrides on your account. Use this for capability discovery (not for quoting) — to answer questions like "Does FedEx support COD?", "What is the max weight for DHL Ground?", or "Which additional services can I add to UPS?". Use envia_list_carriers to find carrier IDs. Note: if the backend returns "Endpoint not yet available", backend ticket C11 has not shipped yet — the tool will work automatically once it does.

carrier_id.description: Numeric carrier ID. Use envia_list_carriers to find valid IDs.

service_id.description: Filter response to a single service ID. Omit to get all active services.

include.description: Optional sections to include. "additional_services" (default) — add-on services catalog. "coverage_summary" — postal-code coverage aggregated by country (may be slow).

tools.name: envia_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: List shipments for your company with filters. Filter by status (1=Created, 2=Transit, 3=Delivered, 4=Cancelled, 5=Incident, 6=Returned, 10=Delivery attempt, 14=Lost, 15=Damaged), carrier name, tracking number, date range, and more. Returns paginated results sorted newest first.

status_id.description: Filter by status ID: 1=Created, 2=In transit, 3=Delivered, 4=Cancelled, 5=Incident, 6=Returned, 10=Delivery attempt, 14=Lost, 15=Damaged

count_only.description: Return only the total count, no shipment data

tools.name: envia_get_shipment_detail
tools.title: Get shipment detail
tools.description: Get complete details for a single shipment by tracking number. Returns sender/consignee addresses, costs, dates, label URL, and creator info.

tracking_number.description: The tracking number of the shipment to retrieve

tools.name: envia_get_shipments_status
tools.title: Get shipments status
tools.description: Get shipment status statistics for a date range. Returns counts and percentages for each status: pending, pickup, in transit, out for delivery, delivered, issues, and returned. Useful for dashboards and performance monitoring.

tools.name: envia_get_shipments_cod
tools.title: Get shipments cod
tools.description: List Cash on Delivery (COD) shipments. Filter by shipment status, payment status, and date range. Returns COD amounts, payment info, and delivery details.

tools.name: envia_get_cod_counters
tools.title: Get cod counters
tools.description: Get aggregated Cash on Delivery (COD) statistics. Returns total COD amounts, delivered count, paid vs pending amounts, and reported shipments. Useful for financial reconciliation.

type.description: Response type: "counters" for totals, "tabs" for tab-level breakdown

tools.name: envia_get_shipments_surcharges
tools.title: Get shipments surcharges
tools.description: List shipments with surcharges (overweight/oversize). Shows declared vs revised weight, extra cost, and dispute ticket status. Filter by tracking number, dates, or ticket status.

ticket_status_id.description: Filter by ticket status ID (e.g. 1=Open, 2=In progress, 3=Resolved)

tools.name: envia_get_shipments_ndr
tools.title: Get shipments ndr
tools.description: List Non-Delivery Report (NDR) shipments — failed deliveries requiring action. Filter by type: "attention" (needs action), "requested" (action already requested), "rto" (returned to origin). Also filter by status_id and date range. KNOWN BACKEND BUG: the "type" filter parameter returns 422 (MySQL 8 HAVING clause issue). Omit "type" to list all NDR shipments and filter the result client-side.

type.description: NDR type filter: "attention"=needs action, "requested"=action submitted, "rto"=returned to origin

tools.name: envia_get_shipment_invoices
tools.title: Get shipment invoices
tools.description: List shipping invoices for your company. Filter by month, year, and invoice status (invoiced or not). Returns invoice totals, PDF download URLs, shipment counts, and billing details.

tools.name: envia_list_addresses
tools.title: List addresses
tools.description: List saved addresses (the company address book). Use whenever the user asks "show my saved addresses", "list my origin/destination addresses", "what is my default origin?" (the default flag is surfaced with a ★ marker), or "find my address in <city>". Filter by type_id (1=origin, 2=destination), free-text search across name/street/city, sort, and paginate. When NOT to use: (a) creating, editing, or deleting an address → use envia_create_address / envia_update_address / envia_delete_address; (b) live address validation against postal-code databases → use envia_validate_address; (c) one-shot address parsing from a free-text string → use envia_ai_parse_address.

search.description: Search by name, street, city, or full address

tools.name: envia_create_address
tools.title: Create address
tools.description: Create a new saved address. Requires name, phone, street, city, state, country, postal_code, and type. For Brazil: include identification_number (CPF/CNPJ). For Colombia: include identification_number (NIT). State must be max 4 characters (state code, e.g. "CX" for CDMX).

alias.description: Short alias for the address (max 20 chars)

tools.name: envia_update_address
tools.title: Update address
tools.description: Update an existing saved address. Provide address_id and any fields to change. Only provided fields are updated — omitted fields remain unchanged.

address_id.description: ID of the address to update

tools.name: envia_delete_address
tools.title: Delete address
tools.description: Delete a saved address by ID. This also removes the address from defaults, favorites, and carrier branch relations. Cannot delete addresses that are set as a shop favorite.

address_id.description: ID of the address to delete

tools.name: envia_list_packages
tools.title: List packages
tools.description: List saved package presets for your company. Packages are reusable templates with dimensions, weight, and content. Use these when creating shipments to avoid re-entering package details.

search.description: Search by package name or content

tools.name: envia_create_package
tools.title: Create package
tools.description: Create a new saved package preset with dimensions, weight, and content description. Package types: 1=Box, 2=Envelope, 3=Pallet, 4=Tube. Saved packages can be reused when creating shipments.

tools.name: envia_delete_package
tools.title: Delete package
tools.description: Delete a saved package preset by ID (soft delete).

package_id.description: ID of the package to delete

tools.name: envia_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the company client book. Use whenever the user asks "show my clients", "list customers", "find my client named X", "filter clients by business/distributor", or needs the client_id required to create a shipment for a saved client. Filter by client_type (independent / business / distributor), search by name / email / phone / external_ref, sort, and paginate. Returns contact and address summaries per client. When NOT to use: (a) creating, editing, or deleting a client → use envia_create_client / envia_update_client / envia_delete_client; (b) ecommerce orders linked to a client (different concept — an order is a purchase, a client is a saved person/company) → use envia_list_orders.

search.description: Search by name, company, contact email/phone, or external ref

tools.name: envia_create_client
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: Create a new client. Requires name and contact.full_name. Client types: independent (persona fisica), business (empresa), distributor. Optionally include billing_address, shipping_address, and use_billing_as_shipping.

use_billing_as_shipping.description: Use billing address as shipping address

tools.name: envia_update_client
tools.title: Update client
tools.description: Update an existing client. Name is always required (API constraint). To update the existing contact, include contact.id. To update addresses, include billing_address.config_address_id. Setting use_billing_as_shipping=true deletes the shipping address.

contact.description: Contact info (include id to update existing)

id.description: Existing contact ID (to update instead of create)

use_billing_as_shipping.description: True = delete shipping address and use billing

tools.name: envia_delete_client
tools.title: Delete client
tools.description: Delete a client by ID (soft delete). The client record is marked as deleted but contacts and addresses are preserved.

tools.name: envia_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List ecommerce orders with advanced filters and pagination. Each order shows general status (Label Pending, Shipped, etc.), payment status (Paid, Pending, COD), and fulfillment/preparation status. Use filters like status_id, shop_id, date_from/date_to, destination, or search to narrow results. For shipping a specific order, use envia_get_ecommerce_order instead.

status_id.description: Filter by general status: 1=Payment Pending, 2=Label Pending, 3=Pickup Pending, 4=Shipped, 5=Canceled, 7=Completed

destination_country_code.description: Filter by destination country ISO code (e.g. "MX")

order_identifier.description: Fetch a specific order by its marketplace identifier

tools.name: envia_get_orders_count
tools.title: Get orders count
tools.description: Get order counters across 7 status categories: Payment Pending, Label Pending, Pickup Pending, Shipped, Canceled, Other, and Completed. Use this to get a dashboard overview before diving into specific order lists. The "other" category includes orders en route, with incidents, or returned.

tools.name: envia_list_shops
tools.title: List shops
tools.description: List connected ecommerce stores (shops) for the company. Returns store IDs needed for order management tools like envia_update_order_address. By default shows only active stores; set include_inactive=true to see all. Supported platforms: Shopify, WooCommerce, MercadoLibre, Tiendanube, and more.

include_inactive.description: Include inactive or deleted stores (default: active only)

tools.name: envia_update_order_address
tools.title: Update order address
tools.description: Update the shipping or billing address on an ecommerce order. Requires shop_id and order_id (get them from envia_list_orders). address_type_id: 1=Billing, 2=Shipping (most common), 3=Origin. Fields address2, address3, phone_code, identification_number, and references are required by the backend but accept an empty string.

address3.description: Address line 3 / street number (accepts empty string)

phone_code.description: Phone country code (e.g. "MX", accepts empty string)

identification_number.description: National ID / tax ID (e.g. CPF, RFC — accepts empty string)

package_id.description: Package ID — required only when address_type_id=3 (Origin)

tools.name: envia_update_order_packages
tools.title: Update order packages
tools.description: Update package dimensions, weight, content, and insurance on an ecommerce order. Requires shop_id, order_id, and the package_id(s) to update. insurance and declared_value are required (pass 0 when there is no insurance). dimensions and length_unit are required for box and envelope types (package_type_id 1 or 2).

amount.description: Number of packages of this type

length_unit.description: Length unit (required when package_type_id is 1 or 2)

dimensions.description: Package dimensions (required when package_type_id is 1 or 2)

insurance.description: Insurance amount (required, use 0 for no insurance)

tools.name: envia_select_order_service
tools.title: Select order service
tools.description: Select a carrier service for a package in an ecommerce order. This saves the quoted service/price so the order can proceed to fulfillment. Requires shop_id, order_id, package_id, service_id, and price. To get available services and prices, use envia_get_ecommerce_order + envia_get_shipping_rates. Pass service_id=null and price=null to deselect a previously assigned service.

package_id.description: Package ID to assign the service to

service_id.description: Carrier service ID to assign (null to deselect)

price.description: Quoted price for the service (null to deselect)

tools.name: envia_fulfill_order
tools.title: Fulfill order
tools.description: Create fulfillment for an ecommerce order package by linking a shipment. Requires either shipment_id (from envia_create_label) or tracking_number. ⚠️ When all packages in the order receive fulfillment, the order is automatically marked as COMPLETED. This cannot be undone. fulfillment_method: normal=standard carrier, manual=manual tracking, automatic=auto-detect.

shipment_id.description: Envia shipment ID (from envia_create_label). At least one of shipment_id or tracking_number is required.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number. At least one of shipment_id or tracking_number is required.

fulfillment_id.description: External fulfillment ID from the ecommerce platform (optional)

fulfillment_method.description: How the shipment was created: normal=carrier API, manual=manual entry, automatic=auto-detect

tools.name: envia_get_order_filter_options
tools.title: Get order filter options
tools.description: Get available filter options for order lists. Returns destination countries present in the company's orders, which can be passed to envia_list_orders as destination_country_code.

tools.name: envia_manage_order_tags
tools.title: Manage order tags
tools.description: Add or remove tags on ecommerce orders for labeling and grouping. action="add": provide order_ids and tags (strings) to assign new labels. action="remove": provide order_ids and tag_ids (numbers) to remove existing tags. Tags appear in envia_list_orders results and can be used for filtering.

action.description: Action to perform: add or remove tags

order_ids.description: Order IDs to modify tags on

tags.description: Tag strings to add (required when action="add")

tag_ids.description: Tag IDs to remove (required when action="remove"; get IDs from order tag records)

tools.name: envia_generate_packing_slip
tools.title: Generate packing slip
tools.description: Generate a packing slip PDF for one or more ecommerce orders. The packing slip includes order details, package information, and tracking numbers. Note: the PDF cannot be delivered directly through MCP (text-only protocol). This tool confirms whether generation succeeded. Download the result from the Envia dashboard.

order_ids.description: Order IDs to include in the packing slip

tools.name: envia_generate_picking_list
tools.title: Generate picking list
tools.description: Generate a picking list PDF for one or more ecommerce orders. The picking list is used by warehouse staff to locate and pick items, with columns for Qty, Description, SKU, Total Weight, and a Picked checkbox. Note: the PDF cannot be delivered directly through MCP (text-only protocol). This tool confirms whether generation succeeded. Download from the Envia dashboard.

order_ids.description: Order IDs to include in the picking list

tools.name: envia_get_orders_analytics
tools.title: Get orders analytics
tools.description: Get analytics about order shipment statuses with counts and percentages. Includes: unfulfilled orders, ready to fulfill, ready to ship, pickup/in-transit, out for delivery, delivered, with incidents, and returned. Optionally filter by date range or store to analyze a specific period or shop.

shop_id.description: Filter analytics to a specific store

tools.name: envia_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List support tickets for your company. Filter by status (1=Pending, 2=Accepted, 3=Declined, 5=Follow-up, 6=In Review), ticket type, carrier, tracking number, or date range. Returns ticket ID, type, status, carrier, and creation date. KNOWN ISSUE: /company/tickets has returned HTTP 422 in both sandbox and production (last seen 2026-04-29). The backend wraps internal errors as Boom.badData, so a 422 here is not necessarily an input-validation failure. If you hit 422, try envia_get_ticket_detail with a known ticket_id, or contact support with the surfaced error body.

ticket_type_id.description: Filter by ticket type ID (use envia_get_ticket_types to see all types)

getComments.description: Include the comment thread for each ticket

tools.name: envia_get_ticket_detail
tools.title: Get ticket detail
tools.description: Get complete details for a support ticket by ID. Includes: ticket type and status, linked shipment and carrier info, consignee address, file attachments, comment thread (if requested), CSAT rating, and additional services.

getComments.description: Include the full comment thread (default: true)

tools.name: envia_get_ticket_comments
tools.title: Get ticket comments
tools.description: Get the comment thread for a support ticket. Each comment shows who wrote it (client or admin), the text, and when it was created.

ticket_id.description: Ticket ID whose comments to retrieve

tools.name: envia_create_ticket
tools.title: Create ticket
tools.description: Create a new support ticket. Requires type_id (use envia_get_ticket_types to see options). IMPORTANT: when the ticket relates to a specific shipment (the user mentions a tracking number or "guía"), ALWAYS pass `tracking_number` so the ticket is properly linked. The tool resolves tracking_number to the internal shipment_id automatically. Tickets created without a tracking number become orphan and cannot be found by tracking-number search later. Common types: 3=Overweight, 5=Damaged, 6=Wrong delivery, 7=Refund, 8=Delay, 13=Theft, 14=Redirection, 25=Delivery attempt.

type_id.description: Ticket type ID (required). Use envia_get_ticket_types to see all available types

tracking_number.description: Tracking number ("guía") of the shipment to link this ticket to. PREFERRED over shipment_id — pass this whenever the user references a shipment. The tool resolves it to the internal shipment_id automatically.

shipment_id.description: Internal numeric shipment ID. Use ONLY if you already have the resolved ID; otherwise pass tracking_number and the tool will resolve it.

carrier_id.description: Carrier ID associated with the issue

credit_id.description: Credit ID if the ticket relates to a credit

warehouse_package_id.description: Warehouse package ID for fulfillment-related tickets

data.description: JSON string with additional ticket variables (type-specific)

tools.name: envia_add_ticket_comment
tools.title: Add ticket comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an existing ticket. Only works on tickets with status Pending(1), Incomplete(4), Follow-up(5), or In Review(6). Cannot comment on Accepted or Declined tickets.

comment.description: Comment text to add to the ticket

tools.name: envia_rate_ticket
tools.title: Rate ticket
tools.description: Rate a support ticket (CSAT). Score 1-5 with optional comment. Rating is ONE-TIME — cannot be changed after submission.

tools.name: envia_get_ticket_types
tools.title: Get ticket types
tools.description: List available ticket types with their conditions and requirements. Each type has rules defining which shipment statuses are eligible, required files, and input fields.

id.description: Filter by a specific ticket type ID

tools.name: envia_get_branches_catalog
tools.title: Get branches catalog
tools.description: Get the full hierarchical catalog of states and localities where a carrier has branches. Returns a map of state → [localities] so you can discover coverage before searching. Use this before envia_search_branches to find the exact locality/state names.

carrier.description: Carrier slug (e.g. "fedex", "dhl", "estafeta"). Use envia_list_carriers to see slugs.

tools.name: envia_find_drop_off
tools.title: Find drop off
tools.description: Find carrier branch locations (drop-off points, lockers, warehouses, third-party pickup sites) for a specific carrier. Use whenever the user asks "where can I drop off a package", "find a FedEx near zip 11560", "list DHL pickup points in Bogota", "is there a drop-off that accepts 50cm boxes nearby", or needs the branch_code required by some carriers when creating a shipment. Filter by carrier + country (mandatory) and any of: postal code, city, state, GPS, capacity type (receiving / delivering / both), shipment type, and package dimensions to validate size limits. Returns name, branch code, full address, distance, capacity, schedule, and phone for each match. When NOT to use: (a) you want the hierarchical map of all states/localities a carrier serves (no concrete branches yet) → use envia_get_branches_catalog; (b) the carrier requires a HOME pickup, not a drop-off → use envia_schedule_pickup; (c) you only need carrier-level constraints (weight, COD, add-ons) → use envia_get_carrier_constraints. This is the consolidated branches-search tool — `envia_search_branches` and `envia_search_branches_bulk` were retired into this one (see _docs/TOOL_CONSOLIDATION_BREAKING_CHANGES.md).

carrier.description: Carrier slug (e.g. "fedex", "dhl", "estafeta", "ups"). Use envia_list_carriers for slugs.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "MX", "CO"). Resolved from locale when omitted.

locale.description: Numeric carrier locale ID. Resolves country code. Use if country_code is not known.

service_name.description: Filter by specific carrier service name.

tools.name: envia_get_notification_settings
tools.title: Get notification settings
tools.description: Get the company notification channel settings. Shows which channels are enabled: email (general + label), SMS, WhatsApp, and event notifications (COD payment, POD confirmation, fulfillment).

tools.name: envia_get_monthly_analytics
tools.title: Get monthly analytics
tools.description: Monthly shipment volume + revenue dashboard, broken down by carrier. Use whenever the user asks "how many shipments did I send last month", "compare carrier volumes / revenue", "what is my carrier mix", "which carrier do I use most", or wants a month-over-month trend across the company. Returns total shipments, total revenue, per-carrier contribution, and the time series for the selected date range. When NOT to use: (a) issues / problem rates by carrier → use envia_get_issues_analytics; (b) shipment count grouped by current status (Created / Delivered / Lost / etc.) → use envia_get_shipments_by_status; (c) ecommerce-order analytics (paid / fulfilled / pending payment) → use envia_get_orders_analytics; (d) date-range invoice listing for billing reconciliation → use envia_get_shipment_invoices.

tools.name: envia_get_issues_analytics
tools.title: Get issues analytics
tools.description: Analyze shipment issues: issue types ranked by frequency (damaged, lost, delay, etc.), per-carrier monthly issue breakdown, and monthly issue rate trend. Useful for identifying quality problems with specific carriers.

tools.name: envia_get_shipments_by_status
tools.title: Get shipments by status
tools.description: Get a count of shipments grouped by status (Created, Shipped, Delivered, Canceled, Lost, Damaged, etc.) for a date range. Only statuses with at least one shipment are shown, sorted by volume.

tools.name: envia_list_notifications
tools.title: List notifications
tools.description: List the company notification inbox grouped by category (payments, returns, shipment events, system alerts, etc.). Returns unread counters per category and overall, plus the most recent N entries per category with parsed details (tracking number, carrier, amount, etc.) extracted from each event payload. Use whenever the user asks "what notifications do I have", "any new alerts", "what happened with my shipments today", or "show me my COD payments". Use the limit parameter to control how many notifications are returned per category. When NOT to use: (a) "are my email/WhatsApp notifications enabled?" → use envia_get_notification_settings; (b) "is there a problem with a specific tracking number?" → use envia_track_package or envia_get_shipments_ndr (non-delivery reports); (c) per-channel notification pricing → admin/billing territory, not exposed in chat.

limit.description: Max notifications to return per category (default: 5)

tools.name: envia_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products from the company catalogue. Supports pagination with limit and page. Pass product_identifier to look up a specific product (the /products/envia/{id} endpoint is unavailable — use this workaround instead).

limit.description: Number of products to return (default 20, max 100)

product_identifier.description: Filter by exact product identifier (SKU) to retrieve a specific product

tools.name: envia_get_billing_info
tools.title: Get billing info
tools.description: Get the company billing information: legal name, RFC/tax ID, billing address, email, and phone. Used for invoice generation.

tools.name: envia_get_company_info
tools.title: Get company info
tools.description: Get the caller company profile: name, country, currency, tier, international status, verification state (KYB), creation date, owner, and connected integrations (Shopify, WooCommerce, etc.). Equivalent to the "Mi Compañia" page in the portal.

tools.name: envia_get_my_salesman
tools.title: Get my salesman
tools.description: Get the contact details (name, email, phone) of the Envia salesman / account manager assigned to the caller's company. Returns a clear "unassigned" message when no salesman is linked, so the agent can suggest opening a ticket instead.

tools.name: envia_get_balance_info
tools.title: Get balance info
tools.description: Get the caller company account balance, currency, credit line (if configured), and auto-billing/auto-payment settings. Use this when the user asks about their current balance, credit limit, or payment configuration.

tools.name: envia_check_balance
tools.title: Check balance
tools.description: Check whether the account has enough balance to cover a shipment cost. Use when the user asks "¿tengo saldo suficiente para enviar?" or "do I have enough balance for a shipment that costs X?". Reads balance from the account — no charges are created.

amount.description: The shipment cost to verify against the current balance (in account currency).

tools.name: envia_ai_parse_address
tools.title: Ai parse address
tools.description: Parse a free-form address string into structured fields (name, street, number, city, state, postal code, country, etc.) using Envia's AI extraction service. Use when the user pastes a raw address or provides it in natural language.

text.description: Raw address text to parse, in any human-readable format.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country hint to improve parsing accuracy (e.g. "MX", "BR", "CO").

tools.name: envia_ai_address_requirements
tools.title: Ai address requirements
tools.description: Get the required and optional address fields for shipping to or from a country. Returns which fields (street, number, neighborhood, postal code, etc.) are mandatory for the selected country, helping pre-validate addresses before creating a shipment. Results are authoritative — sourced from the same rules the carriers API enforces. SANDBOX LIMITATION: chains through the carriers MCP; may return an error in sandbox.

tools.name: envia_create_international_shipment
tools.title: Create international shipment
tools.description: Cross-border shipment pre-flight wizard. Use this BEFORE envia_create_shipment whenever the destination country differs from the origin country (MX→US, MX→ES, CO→US, BR→DE, etc.) or when the user says "international", "cross-border", "customs", "envío internacional", "exportación". The tool: (1) fetches the destination country's authoritative address requirements, (2) auto-classifies HS / NCM codes for any item that ships without a productCode, (3) returns a single ready-to-call payload plus a list of any still-missing fields. Calling this tool replaces the trial-and-error loop where the LLM iterates 6+ turns asking the user for fields it could have discovered up-front. After this tool succeeds, issue a single envia_create_shipment call with the returned payload. When NOT to use: (a) domestic shipment within one country (no customs needed) → call envia_quote_shipment + envia_create_shipment directly; (b) you only need to compare rates → use envia_quote_shipment; (c) you only need to classify a product description → use envia_classify_hscode; (d) you only need address requirements for a country → use envia_ai_address_requirements.

origin_country.description: Origin ISO country (e.g. MX). Defaults to MX if omitted.

destination_country.description: Destination ISO country (e.g. US, ES, DE, BR). Must differ from origin_country.

productCode.description: HS / NCM code if already known. If omitted, will be auto-classified.

countryOfOrigin.description: Manufacturing-origin ISO code (often differs from origin_country).

currency.description: ISO currency code for `price` (e.g. USD, MXN, EUR). Defaults to the carrier expectation when omitted.

items.description: Items being shipped. Each must include description, quantity, and price; productCode is auto-classified if missing.

tools.name: envia_generate_manifest
tools.title: Generate manifest
tools.description: Generate a manifest PDF for shipments ready to hand off to a carrier. Shipments must be in "Created" status (not yet picked up). The carrier is inferred from the tracking number automatically. Returns PDF URLs grouped by carrier.

tracking_numbers.description: List of tracking numbers to include in the manifest. Must be in 'Created' status (not yet shipped).

tools.name: envia_cancel_pickup
tools.title: Cancel pickup
tools.description: Cancel a previously scheduled carrier pickup by confirmation number. Use this when a pickup was scheduled but is no longer needed. Requires the carrier code and the confirmation number from the original pickup schedule.

tools.name: envia_submit_nd_report
tools.title: Submit nd report
tools.description: Submit a non-delivery report (NDR) action for a shipment with a delivery exception. Action codes: 'RD' (reschedule delivery), 'DM' (damaged), 'RE' (return to sender), 'AC' (address correction), 'CP' (customer pickup at branch). Shipment must be in an NDR/exception status for this to succeed.

tracking_number.description: Tracking number of the shipment with a delivery exception

action_code.description: NDR action code: 'RD' (reschedule), 'DM' (damaged), 'RE' (return to sender), 'AC' (address correction), 'CP' (pickup at branch)

tools.name: envia_track_pickup
tools.title: Track pickup
tools.description: Track the status of one or more scheduled carrier pickups by confirmation number. Use the confirmation numbers returned when the pickup was originally scheduled. Returns current pickup status and details from the carrier. SANDBOX LIMITATION: no pickups are pre-created in sandbox — use production tokens or schedule a pickup first.

confirmations.description: One or more pickup confirmation numbers to track

tools.name: envia_generate_complement
tools.title: Generate complement
tools.description: Add SAT Carta Porte complement data to shipments for Mexico. Required by the SAT (tax authority) for domestic road freight. Only supported by carriers with Carta Porte integration (DHL MX, FedEx MX). Provide SAT product codes, weight units, and packaging types per item.

weight_unit.description: SAT unit code (e.g. 'XBX' for box, 'KGM' for kg)

packaging_type.description: SAT packaging code (e.g. '1A' steel drum, '4G' fibreboard box)

shipments.description: One or more shipments to add SAT complement data to

tools.name: envia_validate_address
tools.title: Validate address
tools.description: Validate a postal code or look up a city to get the correct city, state, and country values. Use this before creating labels to prevent address-related errors. Provide either postal_code or city (or both). Country is always required (2-letter ISO code, e.g. MX, US, CO).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. MX, US, CO, BR)

city.description: City name to look up (e.g. Monterrey, Bogota). Used when postal code is unknown.

tools.name: envia_list_carriers
tools.title: List carriers
tools.description: List available shipping carriers for a country. Optionally include their services. Use this to find which carrier and service codes to pass to envia_quote_shipment or envia_create_shipment.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. MX, US, CO)

international.description: Set to true for international shipments, false (default) for domestic.

include_services.description: Set to true to also list available services per carrier.

tools.name: envia_quote_shipment
tools.title: Quote shipment
tools.description: Get shipping rates for a parcel shipment across ALL available carriers and services. Use this whenever the user asks "how much does it cost", "compare carriers", "what is the cheapest option to ship from X to Y", or "quote a shipment". Returns every service the company has access to, sorted by price (cheapest first), with delivery estimates and a per-service cost breakdown. Country handling: for MX, US, CA, BR and most countries provide postal codes (city and state are resolved automatically). For CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO provide city and state instead — postal code optional. Colombia example: origin_city="Bogota", origin_state="DC", origin_country="CO" — DANE codes auto-resolve. When NOT to use: (a) capability discovery for a single carrier (weight limits, COD support, allowed add-ons) → use envia_get_carrier_constraints; (b) listing global add-ons available for a route (insurance, COD, etc.) → use envia_list_additional_services first, then re-quote with the add-on; (c) creating the actual label after the user picks an option → use envia_create_shipment.

origin_postal_code.description: Origin postal / ZIP code. City and state are resolved automatically. Required for most countries (MX, US, CA, BR, etc.). Not needed for CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO — use origin_city instead.

destination_postal_code.description: Destination postal / ZIP code. City and state are resolved automatically. Required for most countries (MX, US, CA, BR, etc.). Not needed for CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO — use destination_city instead.

origin_country.description: Origin country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. MX, US, CO). Default: MX

origin_city.description: Origin city name. Required for CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO (no postal code needed). For CO: use the city name (e.g. "Bogota") — it will be translated to the DANE code automatically.

origin_state.description: Origin state / department code. Required for CO (e.g. "DC" for Bogota, "ANT" for Medellin). For other countries: resolved automatically from postal code.

destination_city.description: Destination city name. Required for CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO (no postal code needed). For CO: use the city name (e.g. "Medellin") — it will be translated to the DANE code automatically.

destination_state.description: Destination state / department code. Required for CO (e.g. "VAC" for Cali, "DC" for Bogota). For other countries: resolved automatically from postal code.

origin_district.description: Origin neighborhood / colonia. Encouraged for MX addresses — some carriers validate availability at this level. Auto-resolved from postal code if not provided.

destination_district.description: Destination neighborhood / colonia. Encouraged for MX addresses — some carriers validate availability at this level. Auto-resolved from postal code if not provided.

declared_value.description: Declared value for insurance (in origin currency)

carriers.description: Carrier code or comma-separated list (e.g. "dhl,fedex,estafeta"). Use "all" to query every available carrier for the origin country (default). Use envia_list_carriers to find available codes.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for pricing (e.g. "MXN", "USD"). Optional.

additional_services.description: Optional additional services for the shipment. Use envia_list_additional_services to discover available services for a route. Example: [{ "service": "adult_signature_required" }]

amount.description: Monetary amount when the service requires it (e.g. insurance value, COD amount).

data.description: Advanced: arbitrary data payload for multi-field services (ETD, hazmat, LTL appointment). Takes precedence over amount when both are provided.

insurance_type.description: Shortcut to add an insurance service. Sets additionalServices with the declared_value as amount. Only one insurance type allowed. "insurance" is carrier-native (CO/BR). "envia_insurance" is Envia platform insurance. "high_value_protection" for high-value packages.

cash_on_delivery_amount.description: Cash on delivery amount to collect from recipient. Adds a cash_on_delivery additional service automatically.

tools.name: envia_create_shipment
tools.title: Create shipment
tools.description: Purchase a shipping label. This charges your Envia account balance. Two modes: (1) pass order_identifier to auto-create from an ecommerce order, or (2) provide addresses and package details manually. City and state are resolved automatically from postal codes. Addresses are validated against country-specific required fields before generation. For BR-to-BR shipments, DCe (Declaracao de Conteudo Eletronica) authorization with SEFAZ is performed automatically — items with productCode (NCM) and identificationNumber (CPF/CNPJ) on both addresses are required. Pass xml_data to skip auto-authorization if you already have it. Returns: tracking number, label PDF URL, and tracking URL.

order_identifier.description: Ecommerce order identifier for one-step label creation. When set, origin/destination/packages are auto-populated from the order. Carrier is taken from the order quote unless overridden.

location_index.description: Which origin location to ship from (0-based). Default: 0 (first location). Only relevant when using order_identifier with multi-location orders.

origin_street.description: Sender street name (e.g. "Av. Constitución" for MX, "Rua Paracatu" for BR). For MX and BR, put only the street name here and use origin_number for the exterior number.

origin_number.description: Sender exterior house/building number. Required for MX and BR addresses (e.g. "123", "60"). For other countries the number is already part of origin_street and this field is ignored.

origin_interior_number.description: Sender interior number / suite / apartment (e.g. "4B", "Piso 2"). Required when the country's address form marks interior number as mandatory.

origin_district.description: Sender neighborhood (colonia for MX, bairro for BR). Auto-resolved from postal code for MX. Provide explicitly to override the auto-resolved value.

origin_city.description: Sender city. Auto-resolved from postal code for most countries. Required for CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO.

origin_state.description: Sender state / province code. Auto-resolved from postal code for most countries.

origin_country.description: Sender country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. MX). Required in manual mode.

origin_identification_number.description: Sender tax/national ID (e.g. RFC for MX, CNPJ/CPF for BR, NIT for CO). Required for BR shipments (DCe authorization).

destination_street.description: Recipient street name (e.g. "Calle Reforma" for MX, "Rua Célio Nascimento" for BR). For MX and BR, put only the street name here and use destination_number for the exterior number.

destination_number.description: Recipient exterior house/building number. Required for MX and BR addresses (e.g. "456", "196"). For other countries the number is already part of destination_street and this field is ignored.

destination_interior_number.description: Recipient interior number / suite / apartment (e.g. "4B", "Piso 2"). Required when the country's address form marks interior number as mandatory.

destination_district.description: Recipient neighborhood (colonia for MX, bairro for BR). Auto-resolved from postal code for MX. Provide explicitly to override the auto-resolved value.

destination_city.description: Recipient city. Auto-resolved from postal code for most countries. Required for CO, CL, GT, PA, HN, PE, BO.

destination_state.description: Recipient state / province code. Auto-resolved from postal code.

destination_country.description: Recipient country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Required in manual mode.

destination_identification_number.description: Recipient tax/national ID (e.g. RFC for MX, CNPJ/CPF for BR, NIT for CO). Required for BR shipments (DCe authorization).

items.description: REQUIRED for international shipments and BR-to-BR domestic shipments. Array of items in the package for customs documentation and DCe authorization. Each item needs at least quantity and price. For BR, productCode (NCM) is also required.

description.description: Item description for customs (use English to avoid delays). Defaults to package_content when omitted.

quantity.description: Number of units of this item.

price.description: Unit price of the item — carriers need this for customs declarations and landed cost.

productCode.description: HS / tariff code, also known as NCM code in Brazil (e.g. "4202.21.6000", "8528.72.00"). Required for international shipments and BR-to-BR domestic shipments. Use envia_classify_hscode to look up the correct code for a product.

xml_data.description: Pre-authorized DCe (Declaracao de Conteudo Eletronica) data for BR shipments. When provided, auto-authorization with SEFAZ is skipped. Obtain this via a prior call to the /dce/autorizar endpoint.

carrier.description: Carrier code (e.g. "dhl", "fedex"). Required in manual mode. In ecommerce mode: overrides the order's pre-selected carrier.

service.description: Service code from envia_quote_shipment (e.g. "express"). Required in manual mode. In ecommerce mode: overrides the order's pre-selected service.

order_reference.description: Customer order number or reference to print on the label

print_format.description: Label format: PDF, ZPL, ZPLII, PNG, EPL. Auto-fetched from carrier if not provided.

print_size.description: Label size (e.g. STOCK_4X6, PAPER_4X6). Auto-fetched from carrier if not provided.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for declared values (e.g. "MXN", "USD"). Optional.

additional_services.description: Optional additional services for the shipment. Use envia_list_additional_services to discover available services for a route. Example: [{ "service": "adult_signature_required" }]

amount.description: Monetary amount when the service requires it (e.g. insurance value, COD amount).

data.description: Advanced: arbitrary data payload for multi-field services (ETD, hazmat, LTL appointment). Takes precedence over amount when both are provided.

insurance_type.description: Shortcut to add an insurance service. Uses package_declared_value as amount. Only one insurance type allowed. "insurance" is carrier-native (CO/BR). "envia_insurance" is Envia platform insurance. "high_value_protection" for high-value packages.

cash_on_delivery_amount.description: Cash on delivery amount to collect from recipient. Adds a cash_on_delivery additional service automatically.

tools.name: envia_track_package
tools.title: Track package
tools.description: Track one or more packages by their tracking numbers. Returns the current status and event history for each shipment. Does not require an API key or OAuth login — tracking is a public lookup.

tracking_numbers.description: One or more tracking numbers, comma-separated (e.g. '7520610403' or '7520610403,7520610404')

tools.name: envia_cancel_shipment
tools.title: Cancel shipment
tools.description: Cancel a shipment and void its label. On success, reports the refund amount (when posted), refund date, and any daily-limit or COD chargeback information. Not all carriers support cancellation — best results within the first 24 hours after label generation.

tracking_number.description: Tracking number of the shipment to cancel

tools.name: envia_schedule_pickup
tools.title: Schedule pickup
tools.description: Schedule a carrier pickup at a specific address and date/time window. You must have already created labels with envia_create_shipment — provide the tracking numbers. The carrier will arrive between time_from and time_to on the chosen date.

tracking_numbers.description: Comma-separated tracking numbers for the pickup (e.g. '752061,752062')

total_weight.description: Total weight of all packages in KG

instructions.description: Special instructions for the driver (e.g. 'Loading dock B, ring bell')

tools.name: envia_get_shipment_history
tools.title: Get shipment history
tools.description: List all shipments created in a given month. Returns tracking numbers, carriers, statuses, and route summaries. Useful for reports and reconciliation.

tools.name: envia_classify_hscode
tools.title: Classify hscode
tools.description: Classify a product into an HS code (known as NCM in Brazil) for customs and regulatory compliance. Describe the product in plain language and optionally specify destination countries. Returns the recommended HS/NCM code and alternatives. Use the code as productCode in items when calling envia_quote_shipment or envia_create_shipment for international shipments and BR-to-BR domestic shipments (required for DCe authorization).

description.description: Product description in plain language (e.g. 'cotton t-shirt', 'ceramic coffee mug', 'smart TV'). Use English for better results.

hs_code_provided.description: Optional: an HS code you already have, to validate or refine

destination_countries.description: Optional: comma-separated destination countries (ISO codes) for region-specific classification

include_alternatives.description: Include alternative HS code suggestions (default: true)

tools.name: envia_get_ecommerce_order
tools.title: Get ecommerce order
tools.description: Fetch an ecommerce order by its platform identifier and get ready-to-use shipment payloads. Returns order details, origin/destination addresses, package dimensions, and carrier info formatted for use with envia_quote_shipment and envia_create_shipment. Use this when the user provides an order number from their ecommerce platform (Shopify, Tiendanube, WooCommerce, etc.).

order_identifier.description: The ecommerce platform order identifier (e.g. Shopify order number, Tiendanube ID). This is the external identifier visible to merchants, not an internal database ID.

payload_type.description: Which payload format to return: "quote" for rate comparison, "generate" for label creation, or "both" (default) for both formats.

tools.name: envia_list_additional_services
tools.title: List additional services
tools.description: List optional additional services available for a shipment route. Use this before quoting or creating a shipment to discover which services (insurance, cash on delivery, signatures, etc.) can be requested. Results depend on the origin country, whether the shipment is international, and the shipment type. IMPORTANT: this returns the GLOBAL catalog for the route — it does NOT filter by a specific carrier. For "which add-ons does {carrier} support?" questions (e.g. FedEx, DHL, UPS specific), use `envia_get_carrier_constraints` with the carrier_id instead — that tool returns the list of add-ons that are actually available for the given carrier on this account.

origin_country.description: Origin country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. MX, CO, BR). Required.

destination_country.description: Destination country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Required for international shipments to get accurate service availability.

tools.name: envia_get_additional_service_prices
tools.title: Get additional service prices
tools.description: Get the pricing for all optional add-on services available on a specific carrier service. Returns standard prices and any company-level custom overrides. Use envia_list_carriers to find service IDs, or use the service_id from a quote response. Useful for showing the cost of insurance, COD, or signature services before creating a shipment.

service_id.description: Carrier service ID (numeric). Available from envia_list_carriers or a quote response.

tools.name: envia_get_carrier_constraints
tools.title: Get carrier constraints
tools.description: Get the full capability profile for a specific carrier: pickup window, per-service weight limits, COD configuration, drop-off support, optional add-on services available, and any company-level overrides on your account. Use this for capability discovery (not for quoting) — to answer questions like "Does FedEx support COD?", "What is the max weight for DHL Ground?", or "Which additional services can I add to UPS?". Use envia_list_carriers to find carrier IDs. Note: if the backend returns "Endpoint not yet available", backend ticket C11 has not shipped yet — the tool will work automatically once it does.

carrier_id.description: Numeric carrier ID. Use envia_list_carriers to find valid IDs.

service_id.description: Filter response to a single service ID. Omit to get all active services.

include.description: Optional sections to include. "additional_services" (default) — add-on services catalog. "coverage_summary" — postal-code coverage aggregated by country (may be slow).

tools.name: envia_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: List shipments for your company with filters. Filter by status (1=Created, 2=Transit, 3=Delivered, 4=Cancelled, 5=Incident, 6=Returned, 10=Delivery attempt, 14=Lost, 15=Damaged), carrier name, tracking number, date range, and more. Returns paginated results sorted newest first.

status_id.description: Filter by status ID: 1=Created, 2=In transit, 3=Delivered, 4=Cancelled, 5=Incident, 6=Returned, 10=Delivery attempt, 14=Lost, 15=Damaged

count_only.description: Return only the total count, no shipment data

tools.name: envia_get_shipment_detail
tools.title: Get shipment detail
tools.description: Get complete details for a single shipment by tracking number. Returns sender/consignee addresses, costs, dates, label URL, and creator info.

tracking_number.description: The tracking number of the shipment to retrieve

tools.name: envia_get_shipments_status
tools.title: Get shipments status
tools.description: Get shipment status statistics for a date range. Returns counts and percentages for each status: pending, pickup, in transit, out for delivery, delivered, issues, and returned. Useful for dashboards and performance monitoring.

tools.name: envia_get_shipments_cod
tools.title: Get shipments cod
tools.description: List Cash on Delivery (COD) shipments. Filter by shipment status, payment status, and date range. Returns COD amounts, payment info, and delivery details.

tools.name: envia_get_cod_counters
tools.title: Get cod counters
tools.description: Get aggregated Cash on Delivery (COD) statistics. Returns total COD amounts, delivered count, paid vs pending amounts, and reported shipments. Useful for financial reconciliation.

type.description: Response type: "counters" for totals, "tabs" for tab-level breakdown

tools.name: envia_get_shipments_surcharges
tools.title: Get shipments surcharges
tools.description: List shipments with surcharges (overweight/oversize). Shows declared vs revised weight, extra cost, and dispute ticket status. Filter by tracking number, dates, or ticket status.

ticket_status_id.description: Filter by ticket status ID (e.g. 1=Open, 2=In progress, 3=Resolved)

tools.name: envia_get_shipments_ndr
tools.title: Get shipments ndr
tools.description: List Non-Delivery Report (NDR) shipments — failed deliveries requiring action. Filter by type: "attention" (needs action), "requested" (action already requested), "rto" (returned to origin). Also filter by status_id and date range. KNOWN BACKEND BUG: the "type" filter parameter returns 422 (MySQL 8 HAVING clause issue). Omit "type" to list all NDR shipments and filter the result client-side.

type.description: NDR type filter: "attention"=needs action, "requested"=action submitted, "rto"=returned to origin

tools.name: envia_get_shipment_invoices
tools.title: Get shipment invoices
tools.description: List shipping invoices for your company. Filter by month, year, and invoice status (invoiced or not). Returns invoice totals, PDF download URLs, shipment counts, and billing details.

tools.name: envia_list_addresses
tools.title: List addresses
tools.description: List saved addresses (the company address book). Use whenever the user asks "show my saved addresses", "list my origin/destination addresses", "what is my default origin?" (the default flag is surfaced with a ★ marker), or "find my address in <city>". Filter by type_id (1=origin, 2=destination), free-text search across name/street/city, sort, and paginate. When NOT to use: (a) creating, editing, or deleting an address → use envia_create_address / envia_update_address / envia_delete_address; (b) live address validation against postal-code databases → use envia_validate_address; (c) one-shot address parsing from a free-text string → use envia_ai_parse_address.

search.description: Search by name, street, city, or full address

tools.name: envia_create_address
tools.title: Create address
tools.description: Create a new saved address. Requires name, phone, street, city, state, country, postal_code, and type. For Brazil: include identification_number (CPF/CNPJ). For Colombia: include identification_number (NIT). State must be max 4 characters (state code, e.g. "CX" for CDMX).

alias.description: Short alias for the address (max 20 chars)

tools.name: envia_update_address
tools.title: Update address
tools.description: Update an existing saved address. Provide address_id and any fields to change. Only provided fields are updated — omitted fields remain unchanged.

address_id.description: ID of the address to update

tools.name: envia_delete_address
tools.title: Delete address
tools.description: Delete a saved address by ID. This also removes the address from defaults, favorites, and carrier branch relations. Cannot delete addresses that are set as a shop favorite.

address_id.description: ID of the address to delete

tools.name: envia_list_packages
tools.title: List packages
tools.description: List saved package presets for your company. Packages are reusable templates with dimensions, weight, and content. Use these when creating shipments to avoid re-entering package details.

search.description: Search by package name or content

tools.name: envia_create_package
tools.title: Create package
tools.description: Create a new saved package preset with dimensions, weight, and content description. Package types: 1=Box, 2=Envelope, 3=Pallet, 4=Tube. Saved packages can be reused when creating shipments.

tools.name: envia_delete_package
tools.title: Delete package
tools.description: Delete a saved package preset by ID (soft delete).

package_id.description: ID of the package to delete

tools.name: envia_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the company client book. Use whenever the user asks "show my clients", "list customers", "find my client named X", "filter clients by business/distributor", or needs the client_id required to create a shipment for a saved client. Filter by client_type (independent / business / distributor), search by name / email / phone / external_ref, sort, and paginate. Returns contact and address summaries per client. When NOT to use: (a) creating, editing, or deleting a client → use envia_create_client / envia_update_client / envia_delete_client; (b) ecommerce orders linked to a client (different concept — an order is a purchase, a client is a saved person/company) → use envia_list_orders.

search.description: Search by name, company, contact email/phone, or external ref

tools.name: envia_create_client
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: Create a new client. Requires name and contact.full_name. Client types: independent (persona fisica), business (empresa), distributor. Optionally include billing_address, shipping_address, and use_billing_as_shipping.

use_billing_as_shipping.description: Use billing address as shipping address

tools.name: envia_update_client
tools.title: Update client
tools.description: Update an existing client. Name is always required (API constraint). To update the existing contact, include contact.id. To update addresses, include billing_address.config_address_id. Setting use_billing_as_shipping=true deletes the shipping address.

contact.description: Contact info (include id to update existing)

id.description: Existing contact ID (to update instead of create)

use_billing_as_shipping.description: True = delete shipping address and use billing

tools.name: envia_delete_client
tools.title: Delete client
tools.description: Delete a client by ID (soft delete). The client record is marked as deleted but contacts and addresses are preserved.

tools.name: envia_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List ecommerce orders with advanced filters and pagination. Each order shows general status (Label Pending, Shipped, etc.), payment status (Paid, Pending, COD), and fulfillment/preparation status. Use filters like status_id, shop_id, date_from/date_to, destination, or search to narrow results. For shipping a specific order, use envia_get_ecommerce_order instead.

status_id.description: Filter by general status: 1=Payment Pending, 2=Label Pending, 3=Pickup Pending, 4=Shipped, 5=Canceled, 7=Completed

destination_country_code.description: Filter by destination country ISO code (e.g. "MX")

order_identifier.description: Fetch a specific order by its marketplace identifier

tools.name: envia_get_orders_count
tools.title: Get orders count
tools.description: Get order counters across 7 status categories: Payment Pending, Label Pending, Pickup Pending, Shipped, Canceled, Other, and Completed. Use this to get a dashboard overview before diving into specific order lists. The "other" category includes orders en route, with incidents, or returned.

tools.name: envia_list_shops
tools.title: List shops
tools.description: List connected ecommerce stores (shops) for the company. Returns store IDs needed for order management tools like envia_update_order_address. By default shows only active stores; set include_inactive=true to see all. Supported platforms: Shopify, WooCommerce, MercadoLibre, Tiendanube, and more.

include_inactive.description: Include inactive or deleted stores (default: active only)

tools.name: envia_update_order_address
tools.title: Update order address
tools.description: Update the shipping or billing address on an ecommerce order. Requires shop_id and order_id (get them from envia_list_orders). address_type_id: 1=Billing, 2=Shipping (most common), 3=Origin. Fields address2, address3, phone_code, identification_number, and references are required by the backend but accept an empty string.

address3.description: Address line 3 / street number (accepts empty string)

phone_code.description: Phone country code (e.g. "MX", accepts empty string)

identification_number.description: National ID / tax ID (e.g. CPF, RFC — accepts empty string)

package_id.description: Package ID — required only when address_type_id=3 (Origin)

tools.name: envia_update_order_packages
tools.title: Update order packages
tools.description: Update package dimensions, weight, content, and insurance on an ecommerce order. Requires shop_id, order_id, and the package_id(s) to update. insurance and declared_value are required (pass 0 when there is no insurance). dimensions and length_unit are required for box and envelope types (package_type_id 1 or 2).

amount.description: Number of packages of this type

length_unit.description: Length unit (required when package_type_id is 1 or 2)

dimensions.description: Package dimensions (required when package_type_id is 1 or 2)

insurance.description: Insurance amount (required, use 0 for no insurance)

tools.name: envia_select_order_service
tools.title: Select order service
tools.description: Select a carrier service for a package in an ecommerce order. This saves the quoted service/price so the order can proceed to fulfillment. Requires shop_id, order_id, package_id, service_id, and price. To get available services and prices, use envia_get_ecommerce_order + envia_get_shipping_rates. Pass service_id=null and price=null to deselect a previously assigned service.

package_id.description: Package ID to assign the service to

service_id.description: Carrier service ID to assign (null to deselect)

price.description: Quoted price for the service (null to deselect)

tools.name: envia_fulfill_order
tools.title: Fulfill order
tools.description: Create fulfillment for an ecommerce order package by linking a shipment. Requires either shipment_id (from envia_create_label) or tracking_number. ⚠️ When all packages in the order receive fulfillment, the order is automatically marked as COMPLETED. This cannot be undone. fulfillment_method: normal=standard carrier, manual=manual tracking, automatic=auto-detect.

shipment_id.description: Envia shipment ID (from envia_create_label). At least one of shipment_id or tracking_number is required.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number. At least one of shipment_id or tracking_number is required.

fulfillment_id.description: External fulfillment ID from the ecommerce platform (optional)

fulfillment_method.description: How the shipment was created: normal=carrier API, manual=manual entry, automatic=auto-detect

tools.name: envia_get_order_filter_options
tools.title: Get order filter options
tools.description: Get available filter options for order lists. Returns destination countries present in the company's orders, which can be passed to envia_list_orders as destination_country_code.

tools.name: envia_manage_order_tags
tools.title: Manage order tags
tools.description: Add or remove tags on ecommerce orders for labeling and grouping. action="add": provide order_ids and tags (strings) to assign new labels. action="remove": provide order_ids and tag_ids (numbers) to remove existing tags. Tags appear in envia_list_orders results and can be used for filtering.

action.description: Action to perform: add or remove tags

order_ids.description: Order IDs to modify tags on

tags.description: Tag strings to add (required when action="add")

tag_ids.description: Tag IDs to remove (required when action="remove"; get IDs from order tag records)

tools.name: envia_generate_packing_slip
tools.title: Generate packing slip
tools.description: Generate a packing slip PDF for one or more ecommerce orders. The packing slip includes order details, package information, and tracking numbers. Note: the PDF cannot be delivered directly through MCP (text-only protocol). This tool confirms whether generation succeeded. Download the result from the Envia dashboard.

order_ids.description: Order IDs to include in the packing slip

tools.name: envia_generate_picking_list
